proposals.before: The Song emperor became Prince of Runan, with a residence at old Danyang. He kept Song rites, banners, and colors. His letters were not called memorials; court replies to him were not called edicts.
proposals.after: The Song emperor became Prince of Ruyin, with a residence at old Danyang. He kept Song rites, banners, and colors. His letters were not called memorials; court replies to him were not called edicts.
proposals.reason: 汝陰 is Ruyin, not Runan (汝南).

proposals.before: Jinxi prince Xie became Duke of Yin'an; the Jiangxia, Sui, Xinxing, and Jian'an princes were demoted to county dukes; commandery princesses became county ladies, county princesses township ladies.
proposals.after: Jinxi prince Xie became Duke of Yin'an; Jiangxia prince Ji became Duke of Shayang; Sui prince Hui became Duke of Wuyin; Xinxing prince Song became Duke of Dingxiang; Jian'an prince Xi became Duke of Lipu; commandery princesses became county ladies, county princesses township ladies.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits the personal names 躋、翽、嵩、禧 and the specific county-duke titles present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Day wuxu: Luan, inspector of Jing, became director of the master of writing, general-in-chief who spreads might, with secretariat equal to the three excellencies, and inspector of Yang; Ying, champion general, inspector of Jing; Huang, west general of the gentlemen, inspector of South Xuzhou; Yuan Chongzu, champion general, inspector of Yu; Cui Wenzong, chief commandant under the general who spreads might, inspector of Xu.
proposals.after: Day wuxu: Yi, inspector of Jing, became director of the master of writing, general-in-chief who spreads might, with secretariat equal to the three excellencies, and inspector of Yang; Ying, champion general, inspector of Jing; Huang, west general of the gentlemen, inspector of South Xuzhou; Yuan Chongzu, champion general, inspector of Yu; Cui Wenzong, chief commandant under the general who spreads might, inspector of Xu.
proposals.reason: 嶷 is Yi, not Luan (鸞).

proposals.before: Princes were named: Luan of Yuzhang, Ying of Linchuan, Huang of Changsha, Ye of Wuling, Gao of Ancheng, Qiang of Poyang, Shuo of Guiyang, Jian of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao became prince of Nan commandery.
proposals.after: Princes were named: Yi of Yuzhang, Ying of Linchuan, Huang of Changsha, Ye of Wuling, Gao of Ancheng, Qiang of Poyang, Shuo of Guiyang, Jian of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao became prince of Nan commandery.

proposals.before: Day yisi: Luan, new director of the master of writing and general who spreads might, prince of Yuzhang, took Jing and Xiang; Ying, prince of Linchuan and general who pacifies the west, took Yang.
proposals.after: Day yisi: Yi, new director of the master of writing and general who spreads might, prince of Yuzhang, took Jing and Xiang; Ying, prince of Linchuan and general who pacifies the west, took Yang.

proposals.before: Second month, day dingmao: the northerners struck Shouyang; Yuan Chonggu, inspector of Yuzhou, broke them and put them to flight.
proposals.after: Second month, day dingmao: the northerners struck Shouyang; Yuan Chongzu, inspector of Yuzhou, broke them and put them to flight.
proposals.reason: 垣崇祖 is Chongzu; Chonggu is an inconsistent misspelling versus s0044.

proposals.before: On day renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Luan, general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying, forward general and inspector of Yangzhou, took Jing.
proposals.after: On day renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Yi, general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying, forward general and inspector of Yangzhou, took Jing.
proposals.reason: 豫章王嶷 is Xiao Yi; Xiao Luan confuses him with 西昌侯鸞.

proposals.before: Prince of Changsha Xiao Huang, rear general, became protector of the army; Prince of Nan Commandery Xiao Changmao, general of the center, took South Xuzhou; Prince of Ancheng Xiao Hao, champion general, took Jiang.
proposals.after: Prince of Changsha Xiao Huang, rear general, became protector of the army; Prince of Nan Commandery Xiao Zhangmao, general of the center, took South Xuzhou; Prince of Ancheng Xiao Gao, champion general, took Jiang.
proposals.reason: 長懋 is Zhangmao not Changmao; 暠 is Gao not Hao.

decisions.reason: Chinese 封宋帝爲汝陰王 uses 汝陰 (Ruyin), not 汝南 (Runan); the proposed replacement correctly restores the fief name while leaving the rest of the sentence intact.

The Chinese names each demoted prince and his county-duke title—江夏王躋爲沙陽公，隨王翽爲舞陰公，新興王嵩爲定襄公，建安王禧爲荔浦公—which the original idiomatic collapsed; the proposed wording restores those names and titles accurately.

decisions.reason: In 以荊州刺史嶷爲尚書令 the person is 嶷 (Yi), not 鸞 (Luan); replacing Luan with Yi corrects a false identification without changing the offices listed.
立皇子嶷爲豫章王 names the imperial son 嶷 (Yi) as Prince of Yuzhang; Luan is a mistranslation of that graph, and Yi of Yuzhang is correct.
豫章王嶷 again identifies Prince of Yuzhang as 嶷 (Yi), not Luan; the proposed substitution matches the Chinese name while preserving the appointments.
豫州刺史垣崇祖 has the personal name 崇祖 (Chongzu); Chonggu is a misspelling unsupported by the Chinese, and Chongzu aligns with the same man elsewhere.
驃騎大將軍豫章王嶷 is Prince of Yuzhang 嶷 (Yi); Xiao Luan wrongly imports 鸞 and confuses him with another clansman, so Xiao Yi is the needed correction.
南郡王長懋 is Zhangmao (Zhǎngmào), not Changmao, and 安成王暠 is Gao (Gǎo), not Hao; both proposed name fixes match the Chinese graphs.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0003–r0005 shows that English Luan on p016 came only from mistranslating 嶷 as Luan in those units; 嶷 is Yi, and Luan is not a source-supported alternate name for this person.
Accepting r0006 shows Yuan Chonggu was invented by the bad idiomatic of 垣崇祖; the Chinese supplies only Chongzu, so this alternate-name claim has no remaining support.
Accepting r0007 shows Xiao Luan was created solely by mistranslating 豫章王嶷; the unit does not name him Luan, so the alternate-name claim must be retracted.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0008 restores 長懋 as Zhangmao; the alternate-name claim remains valid with the corrected English form Xiao Zhangmao.
Accepted r0008 restores 暠 as Gao; the alternate-name claim must read Xiao Gao while keeping id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
